mechanism: Sound static typing with inference, NNBD (null safety) since Dart 2.12. Runtime is still a VM or compiled JS/Wasm; types are checked in sound mode.
why: Flutter needed a single language that was fast to iterate (VM) and AOT-compilable for mobile, with fewer null crashes than JS.
useWhen: All Flutter and Dart-server jobs in 2026.
price: Two compilation pipelines (VM vs AOT vs JS) mean some libraries are not portable; the type system does not erase as aggressively as TS.
